title: Superhost Standards and Assessment Calendar for Host Accounts
content:
# Superhost Programme — Published Standards

These are the published Superhost standards of Host Accounts. They are the same figures in every host tier; the table lists all six tiers.

| Host tier | Lowest average guest rating | Lowest message response rate | Cancellation rate must be below | Completed stays in the lookback | Alternative long-stay route: completed stays | Alternative long-stay route: completed nights |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Starter Host | 4.80 stars | 90.00% | 1.00% | 10 | 3 | 100 |
| Standard Host | 4.80 stars | 90.00% | 1.00% | 10 | 3 | 100 |
| Superhost | 4.80 stars | 90.00% | 1.00% | 10 | 3 | 100 |
| Professional Host | 4.80 stars | 90.00% | 1.00% | 10 | 3 | 100 |
| Professional Host Plus | 4.80 stars | 90.00% | 1.00% | 10 | 3 | 100 |
| Enterprise Partner | 4.80 stars | 90.00% | 1.00% | 10 | 3 | 100 |

## Assessment calendar and lookback (all tiers)

| Item | Term |
|---|---|
| Assessment dates | The first calendar day of January, April, July and October |
| History read at each assessment | 365 calendar days |
| Effect of a suspension on Superhost status | Superhost status is removed at once |

## Reading the standards

- The rating and response figures are minimums: a figure equal to the minimum meets it (4.80 stars meets the rating standard; 4.79 does not).
- The cancellation rate is a ceiling that must not be reached: 0.99% is below 1.00%; 1.00% is not.
- The stays standard has two routes. Either 10 or more completed stays, or at least 3 completed stays together with at least 100 completed nights. Hypothetically, 8 stays and 112 nights meet the long-stay route; 8 stays and 95 nights meet neither route; 2 stays and 140 nights meet neither route.
